parsed.title: Contradictory fallback behavior
parsed.detail: The 'Needs-input guard' section states 'Cwd is used as a fallback only' for `<target-dir>`, but the 'Step 0' section defines the target dir as `[target-dir], default cwd`, which describes a standard default behavior rather than a fallback used only when a required input is missing.
